vo.en: Clueless people are usually the loudest...
vo.fr: Les ignorants sont souvent les plus bruyants...

visual.description: A man shouting through a megaphone in a crowded city square, looking highly confident.

vo.en: It’s the Dunning-Kruger effect. A mental glitch where knowing very little makes you feel like an absolute expert.
vo.fr: C’est l’effet Dunning-Kruger. Un court-circuit mental où l'ignorance totale te donne l'illusion du génie.

visual.description: Abstract blue digital data lines and connection points moving across a dark screen.

vo.en: Beginners climb 'Mount Ignorant.' They lack the perspective to see their own gaps, so confidence peaks early.
vo.fr: Les débutants grimpent au 'Sommet de l’ignorance'. Ils n'ont pas assez de recul pour voir leurs propres lacunes.

visual.description: A man standing triumphantly on top of a small rocky hill, arms spread wide against the horizon.

vo.en: But as soon as you study deeper, that confidence crashes. You realize just how much you don't know.
vo.fr: Mais dès que tu approfondis, cette confiance s’effondre. Tu réalises l'immensité de ce qu'il te reste à apprendre.

visual.description: A man at a desk surrounded by massive stacks of old books, looking overwhelmed and thoughtful.

vo.en: True experts actually doubt themselves. They assume if something is easy for them, it's easy for everyone.
vo.fr: Les vrais experts, eux, doutent souvent. Ils pensent que si une tâche est facile pour eux, elle l'est pour tous.

visual.description: A man's hands performing extremely precise work on the tiny internal gears of a watch.

vo.en: Real wisdom isn't about having all the answers. It's the quiet strength of admitting there's always more to learn.
vo.fr: La sagesse, ce n'est pas d'avoir toutes les réponses. C’est la force d’admettre que l’apprentissage n’est jamais fini.

visual.description: A man looking through a large telescope at a vast, clear starry sky during the night.

vo.fr: Alors, si tu te demandes pourquoi...

visual.description: A man walking away through a busy urban crowd, becoming part of the motion.
